resources.string: You can now attach images, PDFs, and documents directly to your records!
Snap photos instantly right from the app when attaching files.
Your exported PDFs now include beautiful image appendices, exact timestamps, and perfectly formatted tables.
We\'ve polished menus, animations, and dialogs to make NoteCalc feel more premium and responsive.
We\'ve squashed some pesky bugs related to sorting, transfers, and timestamps.
